_README: Declared windows during which OPENROUTER_LIVE_EXECUTION_ENABLED may be on.
This file is the machine-readable form of ADR-0060's revert condition, which
was prose and which nothing executed. It is read by two checks:
1. scripts/live_posture_check.py, run every 30 minutes by
.github/workflows/live-posture-watchdog.yml against what PRODUCTION
actually serves. If production reports a live posture and no window
below covers the current instant, the watchdog opens an issue and the
job goes red.
2. tests/unit/test_live_execution_posture_declaration.py, which runs in
the blocking `pytest (Python 3.12)` lane and refuses a fly.toml that
sets the flag to "true" with no window covering the merge.
TO OPEN A WINDOW: add an entry to `windows` in the SAME pull request that
sets the flag, with a real owner, a real reason, and the instant you intend
to switch it back off. An expired entry sanctions nothing — it becomes
inert on its own, so a forgotten close cannot silently disarm the watchdog.
Leave expired entries in place: they are the record of what was sanctioned.
Timestamps are ISO-8601 with an explicit UTC offset. A window is active when
opened_at <= now < expires_at. A malformed entry makes the whole file
unreadable and both checks alert — a declaration that cannot be parsed must
never be mistaken for a declaration that permits something.
There is deliberately NO maximum window length here. See ADR-0070, which
records that as an open decision for a human rather than a number chosen
from one production sample.
